about_the_game:
Race, dash, and dig as a worm. Unleash quirky worm-inspired items and compete in front of a roaring ant audience as you battle across chaotic maps filled with dynamic elements.

RaceWorms is a fast-paced competitive racing game where you tunnel through dynamic tracks, leaping in and out of the ground to gain bursts of movement speed. Use clever items to hinder your opponents and wriggle your way to victory.

Key features

  • Online multiplayer for up to 6 players, with local play for up to 4 players

  • Combine online and local players in the same match

  • Simple, intuitive controls

  • Full controller support

  • Customize your worm with unique accessories (coming in the full game)

  • Unique items to slow down rivals, including a boomerang, bomb, and time rewind

  • A distinctive picture book–inspired art style

  • Unique sound track and sound effects

Please note: There are no single-player options in the game.
